A should_trigger:false in one member's trigger-evals.json only means 'not this member', so every query no member claims needs a label here (run_routing_evals.py refuses to run otherwise). 'expected' = acceptable family skills; 'allow_none' = no family skill is also correct. Entries here also override member claims (used for the stale resume-tailor cover-letter eval).
